title: Efficient Private PPRFs for Puncturable Key Wrapping
summary: Current PKW and PPRF constructions reveal punctured points after key compromise, while efficient private PPRFs and private PKW schemes derived from them remain open.

formal_statement.body: Construct practically efficient private PPRFs and derive private PKW schemes from them.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography involving private puncturable pseudorandom functions and private puncturable key-wrapping schemes.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct practically efficient private PPRFs and derive private PKW schemes from them.

citations.label: Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications

progress.summary: In its discussion and future-work section, the source explicitly presents finding practically efficient private PPRFs and building private PKW schemes from them as an open problem with immediate applications.
citation_labels: Matilda Backendal et al., Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications
